messages:
anya: noticed a batch of GPU nodes stuck during onboarding in usw3 (12:15 UTC). node-init logs show KMS throttling.
mike: Confirmed `ThrottlingException` from KMS and a bunch of S3 429s from the audit shipper.
rachel: Did we flip any egress rules this morning? I saw an infra PR that tightened defaults.
dave: yes, we pushed egress allowlist change at 11:40 to limit broad outbound; natgw still handles KMS traffic but conntrack QPS looks high.
infra-bot: alert: natgw-2 conntrack utilization 92% (12:13 - 12:18) :warning:
anya: hypothesis: audit shipper full-sample pushed S3 + KMS calls causing natgw saturation -> keystore decrypts delayed -> node onboarding timeouts.
mike: mitigation plan: 1) reduce shipper sampling in usw3 to 10% 2) add keystore service IPs to natgw high-priority route 3) bump keystore client backoff.
sec-bot: note: lowering audit sampling is a compliance-sensitive change. log and request exception if needed.
rachel: I'll apply the natgw route allowlist and monitor. dave: I'll roll shipper sampling to canary now.
infra-bot: deploy: shipper-config/usw3 -> canary started (12:20)
infra-bot: canary success (12:24) :white_check_mark:
anya: after canary roll, KMS QPS back to 50%, node joins progressing. good short-term.
mike: follow-ups: quota-aware keystore client, async local decrypt fallback, and add natgw capacity alerting. I'll open tickets.
rachel: cost note: sampling drop reduces S3 egress and KMS calls, but capture in incident doc.
anya: thanks team. we'll track for 30m then close.
